98065.title: True Merit from a True Melon

facts.subject: Game Commands
facts.text: Use commands to make your way through the Salad Kingdom: Move to a nearby destination, Look for important details, and Check for hidden objects.

evidence.quote: Move - Move to a nearby destination...Look - View the area around you...Check - Have a closer look

facts.subject: Flower
facts.text: Take the red flower in the road for good luck and move forward to the celery forest.

evidence.quote:
Take the red flower in the road for good luck and move forward to the celery
forest.

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: The baby persimmon sitting on the path is in need of water.

evidence.quote:
The baby persimmon sitting on the path is in need of water, so you'll
need to find him some.

facts.subject: Water
facts.text: Move to Lake Quench and take some water from the lake.

evidence.quote:
Move to Lake Quench and take some water, then go back to the celery
forest and give water to the persimmon.

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: Give water to the persimmon and talk to him to have him join you on your quest.

evidence.quote:
give water to the persimmon. Now talk to the persimmon and he'll
join you on your quest. Select the LOOK command to exit the close-up of Percy.

facts.subject: Prince Lettuce
facts.text: Check the bush near the fence to discover Prince Lettuce, and revive the prince with water in order to speak to him.

evidence.quote:
Check the bush near the fence, then move there to discover
Prince Lettuce. You need to revive the prince with water in order to speak to
him.

facts.subject: Pass
facts.text: Give water to the dried up melons and talk to the melons to receive a gate pass.

evidence.quote:
give water to the dried up melons.
Talk to the melons and you'll receive a gate pass.

facts.subject: Gold
facts.text: Look at Lake Quench to discover a nest in the tree, and check the nest to find a gold coin.

evidence.quote:
Return to Lake quench and look to
discover a nest in the tree. Check the nest to find a gold coin.

facts.subject: Town Gate Guard
facts.text: Give the flower to the statue, use the Percy command for a hint, and sneak past the sleeping guard into town.

evidence.quote:
give the flower to the statue. Use the Percy command
to get a helpful hint about the gate guard. Return to the gate now and sneak
past the sleeping guard into the town.

facts.subject: Garlic Wanderer
facts.text: Take a look around at Orange Park and speak with the garlic to learn about an old scholar who lives on the mountain.

evidence.quote:
Take a look around at Orange Park. Speak with the garlic to learn about an
old scholar who lives on the mountain.

facts.subject: Coin
facts.text: Hit the fountain a few times until you get a coin, then be sure to take it with you.

evidence.quote:
Hit the fountain a few times
until you get a coin, then be sure to take it with you.

facts.subject: Coin
facts.text: If you ever see Octoberry go by on Main Street, be sure to check the street for coins.

evidence.quote:
Return to Orange Park, then go to Main Street. If you
ever see Octoberry go by here, be sure to check the street for coins.

facts.subject: Coffee
facts.text: Go to the coffee shop and buy a cup with the coin you got from the fountain.

evidence.quote:
Next go to the coffee shop and buy a cup with the
coin you got from the fountain.

facts.subject: Letter
facts.text: Speak with Mr. Pear at the antique shop to receive a letter to deliver to Miss Peachy at the deli for a sandwich.

evidence.quote:
receive a letter, which you should deliver to Miss Peachy at the
deli. As a reward, she'll give you a sandwich.

facts.subject: Donut
facts.text: Enter the cabaret, move to the restroom, and check the trash can a couple times to find a donut.

evidence.quote:
Move there and check the trash can a couple times to find a
donut; take it with you.

facts.subject: Aspirin
facts.text: At the pharmacy, talk to Mr. Fig a couple times to receive the aspirin.

evidence.quote:
At the pharmacy,
talk to Mr. Fig a couple times to receive the aspirin.

facts.subject: Bookstore
facts.text: Learn about the bookshop near the park, enter the shop, and look around and speak with the clerk.

evidence.quote:
learn about
the bookshop near the park. Enter the shop, look around and speak with the
clerk.

facts.subject: Key
facts.text: Hit the register and take the coin from inside, then check the counter and take the key you find there.

evidence.quote:
hit the register and take
the coin from inside. Now check the counter and take the key you find there.

facts.subject: Farmies
facts.text: Try to leave the bookshop and you will be captured by the farmies.

evidence.quote: Try to leave the bookshop and you'll be captured by the farmies.

facts.subject: File
facts.text: Hit Potato then talk to him to receive a file in the jail cell.

evidence.quote: Hit Potato then talk to him to receive a file.

facts.subject: Interrogation Room
facts.text: Use the file and you will be taken to the interrogation room to meet Lt. Pepper.

evidence.quote:
Use the file and you'll be taken to the interrogation room. Talk to Lt. Pepper
a few times until he discovers your file

facts.subject: Torture Room Door
facts.text: Use the hit command twice on the door, hit it once more to discover a keyhole, and use the key to escape.

evidence.quote:
Use the hit command twice on the door; Lt. Pepper will leave. Hit the door
once more and check it to discover a keyhole. Use the key from your inventory
on the keyhole to make your escape.

facts.subject: Police Station Alarm
facts.text: You can hit the alarm on the wall to set it off outside the jail cell.

evidence.quote:
You can hit the alarm on the wall to set it off but you'll eventually be re-
captured and taken back to the torture room.

facts.subject: Rope
facts.text: To the right is a storage room, in which you can find rope and a few other items.

evidence.quote:
To the right again is a storage room, in which you can find
rope and a few other items.

facts.subject: Lantern
facts.text: Take the lantern from inside the storage room, then use the lantern to disguise yourself and leave the station yard.

evidence.quote:
Take the lantern from inside, then exit the storage room and
exit the police station. Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the
police station yard.

facts.subject: Police Station
facts.text: Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the police station yard to escape and complete Chapter 3.

evidence.quote:
Use the lantern to disguise yourself, then leave the
police station yard.

facts.subject: Mole
facts.text: Check the 3rd hole twice to find the mole hole, use the umbrella to get the mole out, and give him water for info.

evidence.quote:
check the 3rd hole twice to find
the mole hole. Use the umbrella to get the mole to come out. Talk to the mole
then give him some water. Talk to him some more and you'll receive info about
Saladron, plus the left half of some instructions.

facts.subject: Water Wings
facts.text: Give Mr. Leek his umbrella and you will receive a pair of water wings to cross the stream safely.

evidence.quote:
Give him his umbrella and you'll receive a pair of water wings. Use
the wings at the stream and you'll be able to cross safely.

facts.subject: Stream Crossing
facts.text: Use the wings at the stream and you will be able to cross safely.

evidence.quote:
Use
the wings at the stream and you'll be able to cross safely.

facts.subject: Farmie
facts.text: The farmie will always look down, so press down on the control pad.

evidence.quote:
The farmie will always
look down, so press down on the control pad.

facts.subject: Parsley Forest
facts.text: Collect the compass, tin can, shovel and gold found in the maze as you make your way to Saladron's lair.

evidence.quote:
Collect the
compass, tin can, shovel and gold found in the maze as you make your way to
Saladron's lair.

facts.subject: Saladron
facts.text: Use the tin can on the tree to summon Saladron and always select scissors, or left, to win three times.

evidence.quote:
use the tin can on the tree to summon Saladron.
Battle the beast the same way you did the farmie, but this time you'll have to
win three times to vanquish the enemy. Remember the tip you discovered at the
shrine earlier--always select scissors, or left.

facts.subject: Medal
facts.text: Use the shovel to dig up the mound until you find the medal, check the medal, and take it with you.

evidence.quote:
Use the shovel to dig up the
mound until you find the medal. Check the medal then take it with you.

facts.subject: Grape Juice
facts.text: Find Mr. Leek outside, talk to him to end the chapter; if you did not buy grape juice earlier, he will give you some.

evidence.quote:
find Mr. Leek outside. Talk to him to end the chapter; if
you didn't buy grape juice earlier, he'll give you some.

facts.subject: Crest
facts.text: Have a short meeting with the leader of the resistance, General Cantaloupe, and receive the resistance crest.

evidence.quote:
you'll have a short meeting with the leader of the resistance, General
Cantaloupe, and receive the resistance crest.

facts.subject: Clover Juice
facts.text: Talk to Grapy the guard and give him your grape juice to get clover juice.

evidence.quote:
Talk to Grapy the guard and give
him your grape juice.

facts.subject: Nut Bomb
facts.text: Go back to the arms room, which Grapy was guarding, have a look inside, and take a nut bomb.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the arms room, which Grapy was guarding, and have
a look inside. Take a nut bomb and head back to the meeting room.

facts.subject: Resistance Base
facts.text: Leave the base and move to the village to end the chapter.

evidence.quote: Leave the base and move to the village to end the chapter.

facts.subject: Hudson Bee Statue
facts.text: Use the wordbook at the park to decipher the message on the statue.

evidence.quote:
Use the wordbook at
the park to decipher the message on the statue.

facts.subject: Bananda's Cave
facts.text: Return to the cave with the lamp and enter Bananda's cave.

evidence.quote:
Now you should have the lamp, so return to the cave and
enter. Bananda's cave is a maze similar to the Parsley Forest.

facts.subject: Bananda
facts.text: You will run into Bananda near the entrance of the cave; use the nut bomb to destroy it.

evidence.quote:
You'll run
into Bananda near the entrance of the cave; use the nut bomb to destroy it.

facts.subject: Battery
facts.text: Talk to the chief to receive the battery that powers the Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote: talk to him to receive the battery that powers the Dice-O-Matic.

facts.subject: Coins
facts.text: Return to Bananda's cave and collect coins along the way to the Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote:
Return to Bananda's cave and find your way to the Dice-O-Matic. There's coins
to collect along the way.

facts.subject: Dice-O-Matic
facts.text: When you happen upon the Dice-O-Matic, use the medal on it, enter the cockpit, use the battery, and hit the red lever twice.

evidence.quote:
When you happen upon the Dice-O-Matic, use the medal on it and enter. In the
cockpit, check the vicinity and consult Percy; he'll find the slot for the
battery. Use the battery then hit the red lever twice to start up the machine.

facts.subject: War Melon Army
facts.text: Fight the huge enemy Dice-O-Matic and Minister Pumpkin in his Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote:
fight the huge enemy Dice-O-Matic. This
enemy will switch between rocks and scissors, then alternate between looking
right then left during the Look-Away phase of battle. Next you'll fight
Minister Pumpkin in his Dice-O-Matic

facts.subject: Chameleon Grass
facts.text: When you check the root of the giant tree you will discover strange grass to take with you.

evidence.quote:
when you check the root you'll discover strange grass. Take
the grass with you

facts.subject: Chameleon Grass
facts.text: Use the chameleon grass twice to turn into farmies and end the chapter.

evidence.quote:
Now use the chameleon grass twice to turn into farmies and
end the chapter.

facts.subject: Squash
facts.text: Talk to the wanderers, use the crest, and talk to squash to get info about Pea Street.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the
wanderers then use the crest. Talk to squash to get some info about Pea
Street.

facts.subject: Key
facts.text: Talk to Ron a couple times until you receive a key from him in the bar.

evidence.quote: Talk to Ron a couple times until you receive a key from him.

facts.subject: Castle Secret Passage
facts.text: Navigate the passage forward, right, left, forward, then use the shovel to dig away the wall and reveal the cave exit.

evidence.quote:
she'll tell you how to navigate the
passage: FORWARD, RIGHT, LEFT, FORWARD. Return to the passage and follow these
directions. Move forward again after the sequence and you'll hit a wall. Use
the shovel to dig away the wall and reveal the cave exit.

facts.subject: Oil Pot and Chain
facts.text: Take the oil pot and pine tar, and take the mirror and chain you find in the castle storage room.

evidence.quote:
take the oil pot and pine tar. Now check the vicinity
and use the look command. Take the mirror and chain you find.

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: Use the water wings to save Percy, Percy will find an ornament in the pond, and take water from the pond.

evidence.quote:
Use the water wings to
save Percy; if he says you have too much stuff, dump the pine tar (you can't do
anything with it anyway). Percy will find an ornament in the pond. Take some
water from the pond

facts.subject: Hallway Guard
facts.text: Use the ornament to get the guard's attention, use the oil pot, and use the chain to tie up the guard.

evidence.quote:
Use
the ornament to get the guard's attention, then use the oil pot. Now use the
chain to tie up the guard.

facts.subject: Caterpillar
facts.text: Check Lettuce in the jail cell a couple times until you find a caterpillar and take it with you.

evidence.quote:
check Lettuce a couple
times until you find a caterpillar. Be sure to take it with you.

facts.subject: Princess Tomato
facts.text: Show the woman the crest, give her the chameleon grass, and talk to Princess Tomato.

evidence.quote:
show her
the crest. Talk to her until she tells you to get out. Move back, talk to her
again and immediately give her the chameleon grass. Talk to the princess

facts.subject: Fancy Door Guard
facts.text: Fight the door guard to get past him; he is easy to beat if you remember he always looks up during battle.

evidence.quote:
You'll have to fight the door guard to get
past him; he's easy to beat if you remember he always looks up during battle.

facts.subject: Baby Monster
facts.text: In order to solve the maze, you first need to make your way to the baby monster.

evidence.quote:
In order to solve the maze, you first need to make your way to the baby
monster.

facts.subject: Mama Monster
facts.text: The moma and papa monsters always look left during battle.

evidence.quote:
The moma
and papa monsters always look left during battle.

facts.subject: Papa Monster
facts.text: Find the three holes in order from 1 to 3, then go to where the papa monster lurks.

evidence.quote:
find the three holes in order from 1 to 3, then go to
where the papa monster lurks.

facts.subject: Minister Pumpkin
facts.text: To win against Minister Pumpkin, use the following moves: Paper, Paper, Rock, Scissors, Rock, Scissors, Scissors, Paper.

evidence.quote:
Minister
Pumpkin follows a pattern during battle, which repeats itself. To win, use
the following moves:

- Paper
- Paper
- Rock
- Scissors
- Rock
- Scissors
- Scissors
- Paper

facts.subject: Princess Tomato
facts.text: Talk to Princess Tomato, make your way to the garden, and move to the exit to escape.

evidence.quote:
talk to her
a couple times. Make your way to the garden and move to the exit.

facts.subject: Junior Pumpkin
facts.text: When Jr. Pumpkin challenges you to a fight, use the caterpillar on him to beat the game.

evidence.quote:
When Jr. Pumpkin challenges you
to a fight, you can choose to fight him but winning won't accomplish anything.
Instead, use the caterpillar on him. Congratulations, you've beat the game!

facts.subject: Juice Lockout
facts.text: Buying juices in Chapter 2 locks you out of future achievements; do not buy juices on your primary playthrough.

evidence.quote: For your first playthrough do not buy any juices in chapter 2, buying them is incompatible with a few cheevos down the line

facts.subject: Minister Pumpkin Warning
facts.text: Losing against Minister Pumpkin causes a game over, requiring a full restart if going for the no-passwords run.

evidence.quote: Especially Minister Pumpkin - losing against him is a game over, meaning you'll have to restart the whole game if you're aiming for the no passwords cheevo

facts.subject: Diospyros Command
facts.text: Try using the peculiarly-named Diospyros command in the menu before ever talking to or meeting Percy.

evidence.quote: [ElMullet] Help Corner: Try using a certain command before ever meeting the guy it's tied to.

facts.subject: Chapter 1 Full Bag
facts.text: To collect every item in Chapter 1, find the Red Flower, Spinach, Gold Coin, Water, and Gate Pass.

evidence.quote:
[ElMullet] Help Corner: There are five items to find in this chapter:

1) Red Flower (Start)
2) Spinach (Intersection)
3) Gold Coin (Lake Quench, in the nest)
4) Water (Lake Quench, has three uses, must be collected again after using it three times.)
5) Gate Pass (Melon Patch)

facts.subject: Octoberry Coin
facts.text: Very occasionally when you enter Main St Octoberry appears, check the street to find a coin and take it.

evidence.quote: [ElMullet] Help Corner: Very occasionally, when you enter Main St., Octoberry will appear and walk by. When he does, check the street to find a coin. Take it to pop the achievement.

facts.subject: Chapter 2 Route Strategy
facts.text: Beat Chapter 2 without either grape juice or clover juice on the first playthrough to get future achievements, then replay with password.

evidence.quote: the most efficient way through the game is to beat this chapter without either of the juices (no Grape Juice, no Clover Juice), skipping this one achievement. That will get you the two future achievements basically for free. Then, use a password to come back to Chapter 2, and get this achievement by beating the chapter with all items, including the juices.

facts.subject: Jail Alarm
facts.text: Hit the alarm outside the torture room to trigger being recaptured, and escape the same way again.

evidence.quote: [otteroli] Confirming -- Hit the alarm outside the torture room to trigger being recaptured. Escape the same way again.

facts.subject: Chapter 3 Full Bag
facts.text: Collect all Chapter 3 items including the File, Water, Key, Rope, Paper, Bucket, Soap Grenade, and Lantern.

evidence.quote:
[ElMullet] Help Corner: Much easier chapter to find everything in than the last. Here's the list:

File (Start, gift from Potato)
Water (Torture Room, can take some with you before you leave)
Key (Torture Room, get recaptured and check the floor to find the key to escape again)
Rope (Storage Room)
Paper (Storage Room)
Bucket (Storage Room)
Soap Grenade (Jail Exterior, gift from Garlic Wanderer)
Lantern (Storage Room)

facts.subject: Farmie Battle
facts.text: To win Finger Wars against Farmie, press up to pick rock which beats scissors, then press down to look down matching his direction.

evidence.quote: [Aeravon] This happens so fast its easy to not understand. To win, I hit up to pick rock (which beat his scissors), then pressed down to look down which is the direction he looks. You have to do both parts to win.

facts.subject: Farmie Flawless
facts.text: To win against the Farmie without mistakes, just press Right, then Down.

evidence.quote: [YamalVSJamal] Simply put, just press Right, then Down

facts.subject: Parsley Forest Full Bag
facts.text: Getting all items and pouches from the maze according to the StrategyWiki map triggers the achievement.

evidence.quote: [YamalVSJamal] Can confirm that getting all items and pouches from the maze according to the StrategyWiki map triggers the achievement.

facts.subject: Saladron Flawless
facts.text: To defeat Saladron in Finger Wars without mistakes, simply only press Left.

evidence.quote: [YamalVSJamal] Only press Left.

facts.subject: Grape Juice from Mr. Leek
facts.text: Make sure you do not buy any grape juice in Chapter 2, otherwise you have to redo the whole game up to this point.

evidence.quote: [Spaghety] make sure you DON'T buy any grape juice in CH 2. otherwise you have to redo the whole game up to this point. not hard, but still annoying.

facts.subject: Clover Juice from Grapy
facts.text: You can only be rewarded by Grapy with clover juice if you did not buy clover juice in Chapter 2.

evidence.quote: [Aeravon] You can only be rewarded by Grapy if you DIDN'T buy the Clover Juice in Chapter Two.

facts.subject: Arms Room Equipment
facts.text: You have to take the black bean too from the arms room to get this achievement though it is a useless item.

evidence.quote: [RestInPepe] You have to take the black bean too from the arms room to get this cheevo though it's useless item

facts.subject: Bananda Cave Coins
facts.text: Make sure you find all 5 coin pouches in the cave for the achievement.

evidence.quote: [KprojectsKurt] This activated when i took 4 out of the 5 coins inside the cave.

facts.subject: Hachisuke Code
facts.text: You have to get the Wordbook from the store and use it to decipher the statue.

evidence.quote: [Aeravon] You have to get the Wordbook from the store and use it to decipher the statue. That's all.

facts.subject: War Melon Army Pattern
facts.text: Against the War Melon Army, input Down, Right, Right, Left to win.

evidence.quote: [YamalVSJamal] War Melon Army: Down, Right, Right, Left

facts.subject: Chapter 6 Full Bag
facts.text: Chapter 6 items include Carrot, Squid, Wordbook, Peanuts, Broom, Lamp, Skin, Coin pouches, Battery, Medicine, Chameleon Grass, and Right Half of Instructions.

evidence.quote:
[YamalVSJamal] Carrot (Carrot Plateau)
Squid (Convenience Store)
Wordbook (Convenience Store)
Peanuts (Convenience Store) 
Broom (Convenience Store)
Lamp (Chief's House)
Skin (Bananda's Cave)
Coin pouches (all of them in Bananda's Cave)
Battery (after saving Nutty)
Medicine (Hermit's House)
Chameleon Grass (Big Tree)
Right Half of Instructions (Big Tree)

facts.subject: Chapter 7 Full Bag
facts.text: Give all coins away to the wanderer, then alternate Store and Bar until Octoberry walks by to grab coin, buy item, dispose of item, repeat.

evidence.quote: [Spaghety] Give all your coins away to the wanderer. Go in and out of Store, Bar, Store, Bar until Berry walks buy. Grab coin, buy item, dispose of item, repeat.

facts.subject: Yam and Asparagus Feeding
facts.text: Make sure you have two coins coming into Chapter 7 to buy bread for Yam and juice for Asparagus.

evidence.quote: [TheGameingChef] make sure you have 2 coins coming into this chapter

facts.subject: Mama Monster Fight
facts.text: Mama Monster always looks left during the look-away portion of Finger Wars.

evidence.quote: [Aeravon] In my playthroughs, she would repeat Rock-Rock-Paper. So counter with Paper-Paper-Scissors. When you win a throw, look left (the mama and papa monsters always look left).

facts.subject: Minister Pumpkin Pattern
facts.text: Minister Pumpkin pattern: Paper, Paper, Rock, Scissors, Rock, Scissors, Scissors, Paper.

evidence.quote:
[ZTZT] He has a pattern, which he repeats.  Use these moves, and guess which way he'll look.  And as a reminder, paper is right, rock is up, scissors is left.
- Paper
- Paper
- Rock
- Scissors
- Rock
- Scissors
- Scissors
- Paper

facts.subject: Chapter 8 Full Bag
facts.text: Chapter 8 items: Oil Pot, Pine Tar, Mirror, Chain, Letter, Coin, Water, Ornament, Caterpillar, Clothes, Books, Tea Cups.

evidence.quote:
[CassetteCobra] Looking at the gamefaqs guide:
Oil Pot: Storage Room (Using it on Hallway Guard)
Pine Tar: Storage Room (No use, so dump it)
Mirror: Storage Room (No use, dump it)
Chain: Storage Room (Hallway Guard)
Letter: Dark Room (No use, so dump after reading it)
Coin: Dark Room in the third drawer of the desk (Give to Bell Pepper)
Water: Garden (Required for Jail Cell)
Ornament: Garden (Hallway Guard)
Caterpillar: Jail Cell (Jr. Pumpkin)
Clothes: Main Hall (No use)
Books: Minister's bedroom (No use besides giving hints for maze)
Tea Cups: Ministers bedroom (no use)

facts.subject: One-Course Veggie Tale
facts.text: As a warning to anyone attempting this achievement: if you lose versus Minister Pumpkin you will get a game over and have to re-run from the beginning.

evidence.quote: [tranquility101] As a warning to anyone attempting this achievement: if you lose the Rock-Paper-Scissors battle versus King Pumpkin you will get a game over and have to re-run the whole game again from the beginning... T__T

facts.subject: Text Adventure Interface
facts.text: Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom plays similarly to a text adventure with possible commands represented by buttons which line both sides of the screen.

evidence.quote: _Princess Tomato in the Salad Kingdom_ plays similarly to a text adventure, though due to the NES's lack of a keyboard accessory, the possible commands are represented by buttons which line both sides of the screen.

facts.subject: Flower
facts.text: At the starting point you have three gold coins and you may pick up the flower if you like.

evidence.quote: You have three gold coins. You may pick up the flower if you like.

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: In the Celery Forest, talk to Percy when he is thirsty.

evidence.quote: Celery Forest | Percy | Talk | Percy is thirsty

facts.subject: Water
facts.text: Take the water at Lake Quench and you will store up to three drinks of water in a pot.

evidence.quote: Take the Water | You will store up to three drinks of water in a pot.

facts.subject: Gold
facts.text: Check the nest in the tree at Lake Quench to find a gold coin that you can take.

evidence.quote: Check the Nest | You will find a gold coin in the nest that you can take.

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: Give water to Percy in Celery Forest, talk twice, and Percy will join you.

evidence.quote:
Celery Forest | Percy | Give Water | Percy looks relieved. 
Talk ×2 | Percy tells you that his friends have been captured and need help. 
Look | Percy will join you.

facts.subject: Pass
facts.text: Give water to the four melons in the Melon Patch, and the melons will give you the pass to enter the town.

evidence.quote:
Melon Patch | Nappa, Cantalop, Hon Dew, Wat Mel | Give water | All four melons will be revived. 
Talk to Cantalop | You will receive a pass to enter Saladoria Town.

facts.subject: Town Gate Guard
facts.text: Ask Percy for advice at the gate, wait for the guard to fall asleep, and pass through the gate into town.

evidence.quote:
Percy tells you that the guard sometimes falls asleep. 
Go back and return | Keep leaving and returning until you catch the guard asleep. 
Move: Advance | You will enter the town.

facts.subject: Garlic Wanderer
facts.text: Orange Park with the garlic wanderer is the starting point in Saladoria Town.

evidence.quote: Orange Park | Garlic wanderer | | This is the starting point in Saladoria Town

facts.subject: Letter
facts.text: Mr. Pear asks if you will deliver a letter to Miss Peachy at the Deli.

evidence.quote: Now he will ask if you will do him a favor, and deliver a letter to Miss Peachy at the Deli.

facts.subject: Sandwich
facts.text: Give the letter to Miss Peachy and she will thank you by giving you a sandwich in return.

evidence.quote: Deli | Miss Peachy | Give the Letter | Miss Peachy will thank you for delivering the letter by giving you a sandwich in return.

facts.subject: Coin
facts.text: When you notice an Octoberry crawl across the street, check the street to find a coin and then pick it up.

evidence.quote:
Main Street | Octoberry | Check the Street | When you notice an Octoberry crawl across the street, check the street to find a coin and then pick it up. 
Take the Coin

facts.subject: Coffee
facts.text: Purchase a cup of coffee with your Saladorian coins from Mrs. Plum at the Coffee Shop.

evidence.quote: Coffe Shop | Mrs. Plum | Buy a Coffee | Purchase a cup of coffee with your Saladorian coins.

facts.subject: Donut
facts.text: You will find a Donut in the trash can in the Cabaret bathroom that you can take.

evidence.quote:
Check the Trash ×2 | After checking the trash can a bit, you will find a donut (matches). Pick it up before you leave. 
Take the Donut

facts.subject: Aspirin
facts.text: At the Pharmacy, talk to Mr. Fig twice and he will give you a bottle of Aspirin.

evidence.quote: Pharmacy | Mr. Fig | Talk ×2 | Mr. Fig will not hesitate to give you aspirin to cure the resistance leader's headache

facts.subject: Key
facts.text: Check the Counter in the Bookshop to find a key, and take the key before exiting the shop.

evidence.quote: Check the Counter | You will find a key. Take the key, and then exit the shop. When you step outside, government officials will be waiting for you an arrest you.

facts.subject: File
facts.text: In the jail cell, hit Potato to obtain the file.

evidence.quote:
Hit the Potato | Potato will refuse to offer any useful advice until you get tough with him. 
Talk to Potato | He will give you a file.

facts.subject: Interrogation Room
facts.text: Use the file to escape the cell and be brought to the interrogation room with Sgt. Pepper.

evidence.quote: Use the File | You attempt to use the file to escape from the jail, but you get caught in the process and get taken to the interrogation room.

facts.subject: Torture Room Door
facts.text: Hit the door twice to make Sgt. Pepper leave the room, then use the key to escape.

evidence.quote: Hit the door ×3 | The first hit won't do anything, but the second one will convince Sgt. Pepper that you are assuredly trapped, and he will walk away. A third hit will indicate that the door rattled.

facts.subject: Fake Grenade
facts.text: Talk to Garlic wanderer twice at the prison door to receive a fake grenade carved out of soap.

evidence.quote: Prison door |  | Talk to Garlic ×2 | The Garlic wanderer will give you a fake grenade that he carved out of a piece of soap.

facts.subject: Rope and Lantern
facts.text: Take the lantern from the closet and use the lantern to blend in with the guards to escape.

evidence.quote:
Closet | | Take the Lantern | The next time you visit the closet, you will notice a lantern that you didn't see before. 
Exit | Guards | Use the Lantern | By making use of the lantern, you will resemble the guards just enough to blend in with the crowd.

facts.subject: Umbrella
facts.text: Check the bush at Lake Quench to find an umbrella.

evidence.quote: Check the Bush ×2 | The first time you check, you will be distracted by the fern birds. Check again, and you will notice a blue umbrella. Grab it before you return to the crossroads.

facts.subject: Mole
facts.text: Check the 3rd hole twice and use the umbrella to uncover the mole in the Melon Patch.

evidence.quote:
Check 3rd Hole ×2 | This hole is deeper than the others, and turns out to be a mole hole. 
Mole hole |  | Use Umbrella | By creating some shade, a mole will appear.

facts.subject: Water Wings
facts.text: Giving Mr. Leek his umbrella will prompt him to give Percy water wings in return so you can cross the river.

evidence.quote: Give Umbrella | Giving Mr. Leek his umbrella will prompt him to give Percy water wings in return. Now you can cross the river.

facts.subject: Farmie
facts.text: Defeat the Farmie in Finger Wars; if you beat him in Rock-Paper-Scissors, he always looks down.

evidence.quote: Beyond the river | Farmie | Fight | When you cross the river, you will encounter a Farmie. You will not be able to escape from him. The only way to get away is to defeat him in a battle of Finger Wars. This will be your first battle. In truth, it is a very easy battle. If you manage to beat him in the Rock-Paper-Scissors portion, he will always look down, so always choose down to beat him.

facts.subject: Saladron
facts.text: Throwing the Tin Can inside the tree will awaken Saladron; Saladron always chooses paper, so always choose scissors.

evidence.quote:
Sacred Tree | | Use the Tin Can | Throwing the Tin Can inside the tree will awaken the monster known as Saladron. 
Saladron | Fight | The fight against Saladron is even easier than the fight with the Farmie. Saladron always chooses paper, so you should always choose scissors.

facts.subject: Medal
facts.text: Examine the medal you find to confirm that it is the Yam Medallion.

evidence.quote: Check Medal | You must first examine the medal you find to confirm that it is the Yam Medallion.

facts.subject: Grape Juice
facts.text: Mr. Leek will agree to take you to the resistance base, and he will give you a bottle of grape juice.

evidence.quote: Mr. Leek will thank you for defeating Saladron and reclaiming the Yam Medallion. He will agree to take you to the resistance base, and he will give you a bottle of grape juice.

facts.subject: Crest
facts.text: The general asks for your help with rescuing the princess, and presents you with the crest of the resistance.

evidence.quote: General Cantaloupe | Talk | The general asks for you help with rescuing the princess, and presents you with the crest of the resistance.

facts.subject: Clover Juice
facts.text: Give Grape Juice to Grapy, and he will thank you and give you Clover Juice in return.

evidence.quote: Give Grape Juice | He will thank you and give you Clover Juice in return.

facts.subject: Nut Bomb and Black Bean
facts.text: Take Nut Bomb and take Black Bean from the Arms Room shelves.

evidence.quote:
Take Nut Bomb | You will grab one of the nut bombs. 
Take Black Bean | You will take some, but you will be told that they can only be used with the cannon

facts.subject: Hudson Bee Statue
facts.text: Use the wordbook from the convenience store to read the characters below the statue in the park.

evidence.quote: wordbook if you wish to read the characters below the statue in the park.

facts.subject: Bananda
facts.text: After taking a few steps into the maze you encounter Bananda; you can easily destroy it by using a Nut Bomb.

evidence.quote: After taking only a few steps into the maze, you will encounter Bananada. You can't hit or fight it, but you can easily destroy it by using a Nut Bomb.

facts.subject: Battery
facts.text: As a reward for saving Nutty, the chief will give you a battery that can power the Dice-O-Matic.

evidence.quote: As a reward for saving Nutty, the chief will give you a batter that can power the Dice-O-Matic.

facts.subject: Coins
facts.text: There are five pouches in Bananda's cave, all of which contain one gold coin.

evidence.quote: There are five pouches here, all of which contain one gold coin. Collecting them is really optional.

facts.subject: Dice-O-Matic
facts.text: The Yam Medallion fits the indentation in the door which unlocks it and allows you to enter.

evidence.quote: The medallion fits the indentation in the door which unlocks it and allows you to enter.

facts.subject: War Melon Army
facts.text: In Finger Wars the enemy usually alternates between looking right and left, so be sure to choose left or right.

evidence.quote: The enemy usually alternates between looking right and left, so if you beat them at Rock-Paper-Scissors, be sure to choose left or right, and never up or down.

facts.subject: Yam and Aspara
facts.text: Buy juice at the general store and give it to Aspara, or buy bread and give it to Yam, to open access to Pea Street.

evidence.quote: buy juice at the general store and give it to Aspara, or buy bread and give it to Yam, to open access to Pea Street.

facts.subject: Key
facts.text: Radish Ron tells you that he found a key to a room in the castle and gives the key to you.

evidence.quote: He tells you that he found a key to a room in the castle. Since you're on your way there, he gives the key to you.

facts.subject: Castle Secret Passage
facts.text: The old lady confirms that a passage has indeed been dug to the castle and advises bringing a tool.

evidence.quote: The old lady will confirm that a passage has indeed been dug to the castle. She will advise you to bring a tool because it's incomplete.

facts.subject: Oil Jar and Chain
facts.text: Check the closet to notice a jar of oil and some pine tar, then take the chain.

evidence.quote:
Check the vicinity | You will notice a jar of oil and some pine tar. 
Take the oil jar | Percy will tell you that he does not know which will come in handy, but it does not matter, you need to take them in order to see what is beneath them. 
Take the pine tar 
Look | Now that you've taken the jars, you will notice a few more items, a chain and a mirror. 
Take the chain

facts.subject: Percy
facts.text: Use the Water Wings so Percy stops drowning, and notice an ornament at the bottom of the pond for Percy to retrieve.

evidence.quote:
Use the Water Wings | Percy will stop drowning, and notice an ornament at the bottom of the pond. Percy will retrieve it for you. 
Take the Water | Percy will collect some water for you.

facts.subject: Hallway Guard
facts.text: The guard will slip on the oil and get knocked unconscious, and you tie up the guard with the chain.

evidence.quote:
Guard | Use the Oil Jar | The guard will slip on the oil and get knocked unconscious. 
Use the chain | You will tie up the guard with the chain, and be able to proceed without getting caught.

facts.subject: Caterpillar
facts.text: Examine Lettuce in the prison cell to find a caterpillar that he will give to you.

evidence.quote:
Check Lettuce | Lettuce is dirty and when you examine him, you will find a caterpillar. 
Talk to Lettuce | He will offer to give the caterpillar to you. 
Take the caterpillar | You will hold on to it for later.

facts.subject: Princess Tomato
facts.text: Use the Strange Grass on Granny Tomato, and it will have the effect of revealing her true identity as Princess Tomato.

evidence.quote:
use the Strange Grass on Granny Tomato, and it will have the effect of revealing her true identity. 
Princess Tomato | Talk ×2 | Her true identity revealed

facts.subject: Fancy Door Guard
facts.text: Defeat the Eggplant soldier in Finger Wars to advance to the room beyond the door; the soldier always looks up.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Eggplant soldier in Finger Wars to advance to the room beyond the door. The Eggplant soldier's weakness is that he always look up.

facts.subject: Baby Monster
facts.text: In the dungeon basement, find the location where you will find the baby monster.

evidence.quote: **B** : This is the location where you will find the baby monster.

facts.subject: Mama Monster
facts.text: The mother monster always looks left if defeated in the rock-paper-scissors portion of Finger Wars.

evidence.quote: The mother monster starts with three "points," and always looks left if defeated in the rock-paper-scissors portion of Finger Wars.

facts.subject: Papa Monster
facts.text: Like the Mama Monster, the Papa Monster will only ever look left in Finger Wars.

evidence.quote: Like the Mama Monster, the Papa Monster will only ever look left. Other than having to defeat it more times to win, it is the same.

facts.subject: Minister Pumpkin
facts.text: To counter Minister Pumpkin's sequence, use paper, paper, rock, scissors, rock, scissors, scissors, paper.

evidence.quote: To counter this sequence, all you must do is use paper, paper, rock, scissors, rock, scissors, scissors, paper, and so on until you defeat him.

facts.subject: Princess Tomato
facts.text: Move to the garden exit to escape from the minister's compound and return to safety with the princess.

evidence.quote: Garden | | Move to exit | You will escape from the minister's compound and return to safety with the princess.

facts.subject: Junior Pumpkin
facts.text: Because Junior Pumpkin is allergic to caterpillars, use the caterpillar to frighten him so he drops the Turnip Emblem.

evidence.quote: Use the Caterpillar | Because Junior Pumpkin is allergic to caterpillars (or perhaps more precisely, he has a phobia of them,) he will become frightened and panic. He will run away and drop the Turnip Emblem in the process.
